prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production app-store icon artwork for Small Works, one standalone square image, following Tellop's approved modern-v2 icon family.
Image 1 is the SUBJECT CONCEPT to redesign: a compact carpenter's workbench with an hourglass-shaped opening. Images 2, 3 and 4 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY from the approved Tellop icon family. Match their materials, dimensionality, lighting, polish and composition; do not copy their megaphone, journal or mathematical symbols.
Primary request: remake the workbench concept as a beautiful modern icon with a bold, instantly recognizable silhouette. A cohesive family style: refined softly sculpted 3D forms, satin porcelain and gently frosted material, restrained dimensional shading, soft upper-left studio light, clean precise edges, premium calm contemporary software design. This must read clearly at 48 pixels.
Subject: one sturdy, beautifully simplified little carpenter's bench. A thick warm-ivory tabletop with honey-gold edges, and two chunky muted-deep-teal supports whose inward-curving sides create a clear hourglass-shaped opening underneath. A single low honey-gold crossbar completes the bench silhouette. All parts visibly join. Soft generous bevels and satin ceramic-like surfaces. Simplify the source: remove the tabletop holes, joinery patterns, dark seam and surface texture. The tabletop and the hourglass opening are the two large readable shapes. No glass or sand, no loose props, no actual room.
Background: full-bleed warm moss-to-olive-green background with a subtle tonal gradient, gently lighter toward the upper left; a distinct calm natural palette that complements the warm ivory and honey-colored bench.
Composition: 1:1 square, colored background reaches all four edges. One centered symbol occupies about 66% of the canvas with ample even breathing room. Mostly front-facing with only a slight dimensional angle, less top-down than Image 1. Small soft contact shadows consistent with the reference icons.
Constraints: opaque background, no surrounding mockup, no rounded outer tile drawn within the canvas, no white margin, no outer padding or border. The application masks the square corners. No typography, no letters, no app names, no watermark, no rainbow stripes, no decorative specks, no ornaments, no complex scene, no realistic photo. Render just the one app-store icon.
